strikes.name: Light Air Strike
strikes.effect: Declare in the Ranged Attack Phase. Hit: 2 groups of 5 on the target, 12 hits the rear. Miss: no effect.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 200.

strikes.name: Light Bombing
strikes.effect: Hit: 3 AE groups in the target hex. Miss: scatters 1 hex per point missed; hits whatever is there. Buildings: all inside take full damage.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 260.

strikes.name: Heavy Air Strike
strikes.effect: Declare in the Ranged Attack Phase. Hit: 4 groups of 5 on the target, 12 hits the rear. Miss: no effect.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 320.

strikes.name: Heavy Bombing
strikes.effect: Hit: 6 AE groups in the target hex. Miss: scatters 1 hex per point missed; hits whatever is there. Buildings: all inside take full damage.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 360.

strikes.name: Strafing
strikes.effect: Pick up to 5 hexes in a straight line. Roll for every unit there, friend or foe; each hit takes 3 groups.

diagrams.caption: Up to 5 hexes in a line

strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. Enemy air cover can cancel it. BV 440.

strikes.name: Bluff
strikes.effect: Played face down like an air attack. When revealed nothing happens; discard it. Any air cover spent on it is wasted.
strikes.notes: Only with optional Hidden Aerospace Strikes. One per side per game. Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. BV 100.

strikes.name: Light Air Cover
strikes.effect: After enemy air attacks are declared, assign to one and roll. Meet the number for that attack type and it's cancelled.
strikes.notes: Several can go on one attack or be split; assign all before rolling. Low Visibility +1. Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. BV 100.

strikes.name: Heavy Air Cover
strikes.effect: After enemy air attacks are declared, assign to one and roll. Meet the number for that attack type and it's cancelled.
strikes.notes: Several can go on one attack or be split; assign all before rolling. Low Visibility +1. Can't be bought if the game uses BFS: Aerospace. BV 160.

strikes.name: Arrow IV
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 320.

strikes.name: Thumper
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 240.

strikes.name: Sniper
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Target hex takes the first number, adjacent hexes the second. Miss: scatters.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 320.

strikes.name: Long Tom
strikes.effect: Write the target hex now; it lands next turn. Damage drops each ring out: target, adjacent, 2 hexes. Miss: scatters.
strikes.notes: Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 480.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Thumper)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.
strikes.notes: Half the Thumper cost. Uses the Arrow IV Special's attack (p. 148). Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). BV 120.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Sniper)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.
strikes.notes: Half the Sniper cost. Uses the Arrow IV Special's attack (p. 148). Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). BV 160.

strikes.name: Copperhead (Long Tom)
strikes.effect: Guided shell. Only targets a unit hit by friendly TAG this turn; no LOS needed. Hits on 4+ like Arrow IV homing.
strikes.notes: Half the Long Tom cost. Uses the Arrow IV Special's attack (p. 148). Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). BV 240.

strikes.name: Smoke (Arrow IV)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Target and adjacent hexes fill with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.
strikes.rulesRef: Core Rulebook p. 156; smoke rules p. 190
strikes.notes: Smoke rules p. 190; adding smoke to light smoke makes it heavy. Half the Arrow IV cost. Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 160.

strikes.name: Smoke (Thumper)
strikes.effect: Lands next turn. Only the target hex fills with smoke, no damage. Heavy, 2 levels; light at end of next turn, gone a turn later.
strikes.rulesRef: Core Rulebook p. 156; smoke rules p. 190
strikes.notes: Smoke rules p. 190; adding smoke to light smoke makes it heavy. Half the Thumper cost. Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 120.

Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 240.

strikes.name: Light Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.
strikes.notes: Any non-water hex. Max 6 groups per hex per player. Infantry, hovercraft and VTOLs never trigger it. Not a Strike (no 3-per-turn limit). BV 60.

strikes.name: Medium Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.
strikes.notes: Any non-water hex. Max 6 groups per hex per player. Infantry, hovercraft and VTOLs never trigger it. Not a Strike (no 3-per-turn limit). BV 100.

strikes.name: Heavy Density Minefield
strikes.effect: Secretly written down before deployment. A unit entering rolls vs TN: on a hit it takes the groups and the field loses 1 group.
strikes.notes: Any non-water hex. Max 6 groups per hex per player, so one Heavy fills a hex. Infantry, hovercraft and VTOLs never trigger it. Not a Strike. BV 160.
